title: Sr. Designer - Visual Design 4B
description:
Sr. Designer \- Visual Design**Ready to turn bold ideas into real\-world impact?**  

 At Genpact, we don’t just adapt to change, we lead it. AI and digital innovation are transforming the way businesses work, and we’re at the forefront of it. Genpact’s AI Gigafactory, our industry\-first accelerator, exemplifies how we scale advanced technology solutions to help global enterprises work smarter, grow faster, and transform at scale. Whether tackling complex challenges through large\-scale models or agentic AI, our breakthrough solutions tackle companies’ most complex challenges.  

  

If you thrive in a fast\-moving, innovation\-driven environment, love building and deploying cutting\-edge AI solutions, and want to push the boundaries of what’s possible, this is your moment.  

  

Genpact (NYSE: G) is an agentic and advanced technology solutions company. We leverage process intelligence and artificial intelligence to deliver measurable outcomes. With a strong partner ecosystem and decades of client trust, we provide innovative solutions that transform how businesses run. Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.  

 Get to know us at genpact.com and on LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and Facebook.

**Job Description**

* Create and edit eLearning, videos, presentations, and infographics.
* Operate tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, After Effects, Illustrator, InDesign, CorelDraw, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Microsoft PowerPoint design, etc.
	+ Working knowledge of tools such as StrivR \- virtual reality platform, Gooroo, HeyGen, Eleven Labs, Canva, Vimio, Apple Vision Pro, Adobe Express, various Google AI tools (Gemini, NotebookLM, etc)
* Create and edit motion graphics, audio\-video, and animations.
* Translate concepts into working models—while keeping in mind the design aesthetics, brand guidelines, templates, and latest design standards.
* Create graphics and layouts for eLearning, PowerPoint presentations, product illustrations, digital banners, e\-mails, collaterals, newsletters, social media creatives, web layouts, etc.
* Conceptualize slides, displays, and templates into visually appealing designs to ensure maximum engagement.
* Ensure compliance with the company’s guidelines, deadlines, and latest design standards.

### **Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in any field
* Proficient in working with the following tools:
	+ Adobe Creative Cloud Applications for video editing, interactive media, etc.
	+ Adobe After Effects
	+ MS PowerPoint
	+ Graphics/Motion Graphics
	+ Adobe Photoshop
	+ Adobe Illustrator
	+ Articulate Storyline and Rise
	+ StrivR \- virtual reality platform
	+ Content Development platforms such as Gooroo, HeyGen, Eleven Labs, Canva, Vimio, Apple Vision Pro, Adobe Express
	+ Google AI tools (Gemini, NotebookLM, etc.)
* A good understanding of the audience perspective and the ability to perceive content in various business settings.
* In\-depth knowledge of infographics, data visualization concepts, and PowerPoint's graphing tools.
* A well\-rounded experience in corporate branding, layout, color theory, typography, along with excellent written and verbal communication skills
